categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies RPC method implementation in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a correctness flaw where scanblocks silently dropped unindexed block filter ranges and returned an incomplete relevant_blocks list as if it were complete. In the RPC area, where correctness of returned data matters most, preventing silent false negatives during background index synchronization is an important bug fix.
